name: Four Knights Game
description: A calm open game where both sides develop knights quickly and fight for central squares.

moves.explanation: White opens the center and frees the kingside bishop.
White develops a knight and attacks e5.
Black defends e5 with a developing move.
White develops the second knight toward the center.
Black completes the four-knight setup and attacks e4.

ideas: Develop knights before bishops when the center is open.
Castle early after the kingside bishop moves.
Watch both central pawns because the knights attack them quickly.
commonMistakes: Moving the same knight repeatedly in the opening.
Forgetting that e4 and e5 are both attacked.
